goal: Test whether a depth-built STATIC obstacle map can safely finish a G1 nominal detour when camera loses visual contact

baseline.result: not goal, no contacts, 22/160 detections, 800 ticks, stop_lost_obstacle

candidate.method: post-first-waypoint static-map memory with remaining-segment clearance >= route inflated radius+0.25 m, fresh depth frames mandatory

gate.safety: stop on stale depth frames or uncertified segment clearance
gate.pass: goal reached and zero cylinder contacts, whole clip from real simulator
gate.unacceptable: using evaluator true cylinder coordinates in navigation

status_rule: Do not claim successful route or VLA merely because the MP4 exists; preserve negative result and stop provider
